exploitability.attacker: prompt-injection in untrusted content the assistant ingests (or a malfunctioning model) steering a draw_with_turtle call
exploitability.capability: influence over the tool's normal 'program' string input
exploitability.boundary: the A2 pre-parse nesting guard nestingDepthRefusal, whose stated purpose is to refuse pathological programs before the recursive-descent parser crashes
exploitability.harm: a ~16-32KB program of bare prefix tokens (forward + '- 'x16000 + 1) or not/!/chunk-of chains passes the 64KB cap and the depth-0 guard, then overflows the parser stack (SIGBUS) inside validate() BEFORE the allowlist walk or execution — host crash, unsaved-work loss (availability; no sandbox escape)
exploitability.fix: extend nestingDepthRefusal to count consecutive prefix-operator runs (.minus/.not/!/.await) and chunk of-chain depth in the same flat non-recursive pass, refusing above a safe cap (and/or an internal recursion cap in parseUnary/parseNot/parsePrimary); add a robustness test pushing ~2x the cap of bare '- '/'not '/'item 1 of ' chains through validate asserting clean .refused
